lines.text: Many learners say: Can I have a prospect for the hotel?
Better: Can I have a brochure for the hotel?
A brochure is a small paper book.
Brochure! Can I have a brochure for the hotel?

en.tip: A “Prospekt” is a “brochure” in English. “Prospect” means “Aussicht.”
en.caption: A “Prospekt” is a “brochure”! Wrong: “Can I have a prospect for the hotel?” Right: “Can I have a brochure for the hotel?” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
